queryOutcomes: Separate English and Tamil discovery queries were performed. Both identified first-party Tamil Nadu land-record/cadastral services; English discovery also identified the official Sivaganga district custodian page and Government Services Portal description. Search did not expose a parcel JSON/API response.
requestOutcomes: TN-GLMS HTML was retrieved over TLS and documented land-parcel/FMB integration but no anonymous parcel endpoint. eservices.tn.gov.in and tngis.tn.gov.in timed out in bounded TLS-verified curl requests. The district page and service descriptions did not expose a bounded parcel ID+geometry response, so no parcel API request was sent.
